item.title: Episode 13: ASD cuts off an Amadey botnet, PHP2Shell enters CISA KEV and Microsoft pulls eMudhra roots, 28 October 2026
item.description: The Australian Signals Directorate says it cut a criminal's Amadey malware operation off from about 180,000 infected computers and destroyed a stolen 5 TB data haul before it could be sold. CISA has added the PHP2Shell flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue, and Microsoft has removed eMudhra root certificates from Windows after weak keys were found. We also cover Tailworm fixes for Tailscale, critical HPE Aruba patches, the University of New Mexico Health attack, and an AI pentesting framework used in a South Korean extortion spree. Australia ASD disrupts an Amadey botnet and destroys stolen data. About 180,000 computers, including in Australia, disconnected from one criminal's controller; 5 TB of stolen business data, including about 4.8 million files from Australians, destroyed before sale. Earlier theft is not undone, so revoke credentials and sessions from affected machines. ABC News ; The Hacker News ASD warns of more frequent disruptions to essential services as AI scales attacks. Includes new incident response protocols with AI labs. ABC AM Global threats PHP2Shell added to CISA KEV. CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, federal patch deadline 29 October (US); more than 10 million of about 42 million exposed PHP services patched since 21 October. The Record ; The Hacker News Tailscale prepares Tailworm fixes. Eleven findings published before patches; Tailscale SSH flaws can give root on reachable servers where forwarding is allowed. Disable SSH forwarding where not needed until the update ships. SecurityWeek Microsoft removes eMudhra roots from Windows. Out-of-band updates (including KB5134133 and KB5134125) after eight eMudhra intermediate keys proved trivially recoverable; update disconnected systems and replace dependent certificates. MSRC ; BleepingComputer HPE patches 72 Aruba AOS flaws, 33 critical. Eight maximum-severity bugs (CVE-2026-79844 to CVE-2026-79851); fixed in AOS 8.10.0.24, 8.13.3.1, 10.4.1.14, 10.7.2.7 and 10.8.1.2. SecurityWeek University of New Mexico Health diverts ambulances after cyberattack. Services resumed Tuesday; BYOD ransomware claim unverified. The Record Apple backports exploited CoreGraphics fix to iOS 18.7.11. CVE-2026-86950; 27.2 releases fix hundreds more. The Hacker News Microsoft Authenticator for Android token theft flaw fixed. CVE-2026-80097; update to 6.2606.4246 or later. The Hacker News Lazarus Operation FlashHole targets South Korea. Fake résumé sites and abuse of INISAFE CrossWeb EX. The Hacker News UK police suppliers repeatedly breached, watchdog finds. The Record AI security ARTEX AI framework used to breach about 90 South Korean organisations. 8.2 million records stolen; 38 extortion demands. BleepingComputer ; EDAILY Warp discloses vendor breach exposing agent traces and telemetry. Up to about 1 per cent of users; CEO attributes it to an agent swarm. BleepingComputer Aokigahara infostealer targets AI assistant sessions. Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and more, plus Git, SSH and cloud credentials. Dark Reading Industry Anthropic's IPO filing devotes 93 pages to risk factors, including runaway AI. SecurityWeek Outlook and patch priorities Critical: PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 (Windows -1 builds) plus a compromise check on hosts exposed since 21 October; HPE Aruba AOS updates with isolated management interfaces. High: Tailscale client update when released (disable SSH forwarding meanwhile); eMudhra out-of-band update for disconnected Windows systems; Authenticator for Android 6.2606.4246; iOS 18.7.11 or 27.2. Hygiene: rotate AI tool, Git and cloud tokens on any workstation with a past infostealer infection.

item.title: Episode 12: PHP2Shell shells confirmed, Brotli emergency patches and GitHub secrets stolen through Actions logs, 27 October 2026
item.description: Attackers have now launched working shells through the PHP2Shell flaws on research honeypots, the clearest public proof yet that the exploits work. The Brotli compression flaw has triggered emergency fixes from Microsoft for .NET and rebuilt PHP packages for Windows, and a campaign called Gheist is using stolen GitHub tokens to dump repository secrets through GitHub Actions logs. We also cover the ACSC's annual cyber threat report, Microsoft 365 token replay, Teams help desk scams and Anthropic's account of Mythos 5 attacking real people during an evaluation. Australia ASD's ACSC Annual Cyber Threat Report 2025-26. More than 1,500 incidents handled (up over 20 per cent) and more than 4,400 notifications of potential malicious activity (up almost 80 per cent); AI and faster patching are the key themes. ASD's ACSC ; Media release ACSC blog on AI-enabled supply chain and cloud attacks. Lessons from the ConnectWise app identity campaign: restrict OAuth consent, enforce least privilege for application identities, protect service principals. ASD's ACSC Global threats PHP2Shell: working shells confirmed. 35 shells across three Apache mod_php honeypots from two IP addresses on 24 October, using a chain matching the public proof of concept; favourable test setup, no second-stage payload; still not in CISA KEV. SecurityWeek ; BleepingComputer PHP rebuilds Windows packages for the Brotli flaw. New builds 8.5.12-1, 8.4.27-1, 8.3.36-1 and 8.2.35-1; reachable through cURL automatic decompression, which Guzzle enables by default; php -v shows no change, so check the file name or hash. The Hacker News Brotli CVE-2026-111497 (HTTP2Shell, Node2Shell): emergency patches including .NET. .NET is affected only where apps opt in to Brotli decompression (fixed in 8.0.33, 9.0.22, 10.0.14). Fixed in Brotli 1.0.10, 1.1.1, 1.2.1, Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1, 26.12.1, Python Brotli 1.2.1 and brotlicffi 1.2.1.0; public proofs of concept, no exploitation reported; restart processes and rebuild images. BleepingComputer ; BleepingComputer, .NET Gheist steals GitHub secrets through Actions logs. More than 13,500 planted ci-sync branches from more than 850 compromised accounts; succeeds in private repositories and GitHub Enterprise Server. Indicators: user agent gheist, branch pattern ci-sync- plus six characters, file .github/workflows/sync-check.yml, commit message "ci: sync config", files .gdmp_pat, .gdmp_patg, .gdmp_sweep.
